title.narrative: Food basket in the Republic of Albania for the year 2024

description.narrative: A food basket project in Albania for the year 2024 AD to meet the needs of the most needy families in 35 Albanian governorates by providing them with food baskets. Helping heads of needy families to bear the food expenses for their families. Supporting the neediest families, standing with them, and making them feel solidarity and social solidarity.
Distribution of 5,300 food baskets to 35 governorates, benefiting 31,800 beneficiaries.
Providing and distributing food baskets to the most needy families in the Republic of Albania, sufficient for one family for a month and containing basic foodstuffs.
